children.text: The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
The benefit is provided to accident victims and individuals requiring emergency services.

children.text: In any type of medical emergency, patients are transported to the hospital and provided with first aid facilities.
The benefits of this service are being provided to the residents of the state through 272 ambulances.

schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide timely emergency medical assistance by transporting patients to hospitals and offering essential first aid through a free, state-wide ambulance service accessible by calling 108.

children.text: The “108 Emergency Ambulance Service” is implemented by the Department of Medical Health and Family Welfare, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to provide immediate medical assistance during emergencies by ensuring quick patient transportation to hospitals and offering essential first aid.
